Structured dynamic observation and descriptor failures; linking deferred and no frontend integration.
Bounded string-reference failures carry source-table token, offset and scan context.
Dynamic dependency interpretation failures with original entry context; no resolution or frontend integration.
Generic byte-name invariants reject empty and embedded NUL; UTF-8 is optional explicit validation.

Typed evidence target/source/module mismatch at immutable session composition; no target loading or report reclassification.
Native requested path, acquisition operation, size/read limits and nested I/O failure; no parser or loading action.
Missing/duplicate/unknown selection flags and invalid explicit limits. Native path values stay opaque.
Immutable source-bound header budget or existing ELF failure; complete means header scope only.
Explicit inspection requires an acquired source; Ready/Failed acquisition is not inspected.
Source-bound independent raw dynamic report, explicit header/entry budgets, no descriptor interpretation.

Bounded source/proof, relocation-index and shared name-budget failures. Candidate evidence only; no resolution.
Identity record and aggregate name budgets, prerequisite/discovery/string failures; conflicts remain explicit metadata evidence. No provider resolution.
